note: A pin candidate plus what has actually been started. Nothing here is a build this repository produced: the image is upstream's, pulled by digest. docs/INSTALLATION.md section 2 keeps the same rule as every other versions.json here - re-resolve the digest for the platform you run before setting LO_HOMEPAGE_IMAGE.

digest_provenance.method: anonymous pull token, then HEAD with the OCI index and Docker manifest-list Accept types; Docker-Content-Digest is the value recorded above. The per-platform digests came from the manifest list that same GET returns.
digest_provenance.cross_checked_against: Use the component contract and reviewed upstream pin; validate against your installation.
digest_provenance.why_not_the_registry_tag_list: GHCR caps /v2/<name>/tags/list at 100 entries and this repository's tags run past that, so absence from that page proves nothing; a tag is resolved by requesting its manifest by name and reading Docker-Content-Digest.

actually_run.statement: v1.13.2 is the only version of this image anything in this repository has started and served. The reference example (examples/full/compose.yaml) has never started any version of it, so this pin is proven by the staging rehearsal and by the registry read above, not by a run against examples/full.
actually_run.evidence: components/control/homepage/conformance.md records which clauses of the acceptance scenario are named tests and which are not-run.

candidate.state: exists and resolves; not adopted. v1 to v2 is a major version and nothing in this repository has run it, so its config keys, its /api/revalidate behaviour and the HOMEPAGE_FILE_ substitution this manifest depends on are all unverified against it. Move by upgrade.md, never by editing this file alone.
candidate.not_adopted_because: the row this component closes is about shipping a portal, not about a version upgrade, and the release schema pins the version itself: local_observe/deployment/release.py declares contracts.homepage as the JSON-Schema const '1.13.2', which tests/test_release.py asserts, so a v2 image is a release-contract change with its own PR, not a line in this file.

depends_on.readiness_bootstrap: scripts/homepage_start.cjs, mounted at /bootstrap.cjs through LO_HOMEPAGE_BOOTSTRAP. Verified against v1.13.2 only: it spawns server.js, polls /api/revalidate for revalidated: true and writes /tmp/portal-ready, which is the healthcheck's only input. Whether v2.x keeps that endpoint is an open item in upgrade.md.

distribution: upstream image pulled by digest; this repository builds nothing here, publishes no image and claims no signature
